column2: The  general  objects  for  which  the  Corporation  is

column1: constituted are hereby declared to be—

column2: to award prizes and scholarships to needy school
children to enable them to continue their eduction
and to encourage them to attend school regularly ;
to establish and maintain libraries including mobile
libraries to assist the students in their educational
activities  ;
to  organize  seminars,  workshops,  lectures,
exhibitions,  and  educational  tours  with  a  view  to
promoting  the  educational  activities  of  school
children  ;
provide  for  loan  schemes  and  other  assistance  to
school principals and teachers in order to encourage
them to enhance their professional knowledge ;
to  award  scholarships  to  deserving  students
selected  to  follow  courses  at  Universities  and
technical  Colleges ;
to introduce self-employment opportunities, loans
and  savings  schemes  and  vocational  training  and
computer traning centres for school leavers ;
to  establish  and  maintain  per-schools  for  early
childhood development of the needy children ;
to grant lands and houses to needy families who do
not own lands or houses ;
to supply wheel chairs and other medical equipment
to hospitals and to provide medical relief and food
for  the  needy,  destitute  and  sick,  establish  and
maintain  houses  for  displaced  persons  and  elders
